title: Plan Servicing Console Reference: Enrolling Encounter Charges on a Proposed Patient Payment Plans Plan
content:
A proposed plan under the Patient Payment Plans carries every eligible charge of the encounters it enrolls: a charge the financial account posts for an encounter already enrolled on a proposed plan, and not yet on that plan, is enrolled on it as an initial enrollment, one charge per entry.

## Scope

| Situation on the records | Result |
|---|---|
| A charge on the Patient Financial Account for an encounter already enrolled on a proposed plan, with no enrollment entry for it on that plan | The charge is enrolled on that plan as an initial enrollment entry |
| Several such charges | Each is enrolled by its own entry, one charge per entry |
| A charge already on the plan | Not enrolled again under this rule |

The encounter is identified by the encounter to which the charges on the financial account are posted; a charge belongs to an enrolled encounter when it is posted to the same encounter as a charge the proposed plan already carries.

## Console action: `enroll_encounter_charge_372696d1`

**Capability.** Enrolls one financial-account charge on a payment plan that is still a proposal, as an initial enrollment of that charge. One call adds one plan ledger entry of the kind "balance enrolled" with the enrollment reason `initial_enrollment`, dated today and pointing at the charge, and raises the plan's remaining balance by the amount given. The charge itself on the financial account is not changed.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `enroll_encounter_charge_372696d1`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payment_plan_id` | Reference number of the proposed payment plan the charge is enrolled on, as shown by the payment plan lookup for the patient | Identifier |
| `billing_txn_id` | Reference number of the financial-account charge being enrolled, as shown by the financial account ledger lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | The amount of the charge enrolled on the plan | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; stored exactly as given, rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new plan ledger entry reference (text beginning "ppt_"), the charge reference, the payment plan reference, the amount enrolled in USD with 2 decimal places and the plan's remaining balance including the entry in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving this sentence means the enrollment is booked; afterwards a lookup of the plan ledger by the charge reference shows the enrollment, and the plan's remaining balance includes it.
